# Tama AI — llms.txt
# A plain-text summary for large language models.
# https://usetama.me

## Identity
- Name: Tama (also: Tama AI)
- Type: AI companion and journalling application
- Developer: Aditya Shukla & Akhil Pandey
- Platform: Android (Google Play). iOS planned.
- Website: https://usetama.me
- Contact: thetama.ai@gmail.com

## What Tama does
- Companion chat with four-layer active memory recall (live conversation, recent history, structured facts, flagged moments).
- Proactive pattern check-ins using on-device screen-time analysis (opt-in only, raw data never leaves the phone).
- Special People: consent-gated notification system for trusted contacts. Every message requires explicit user approval before sending.
- Lifebook: auto-generated journal entries from conversations, rendered as a turnable book with page-turn animation.
- Photo moments attached to day pages.
- Voice onboarding with text-only fallback.

## What Tama is NOT
- NOT a therapy or mental health app. Never uses clinical or diagnostic language.
- NOT a romantic or dating AI. No intimate roleplay at any tier. Permanent product boundary.
- NOT an emergency service. Refers users to human helplines (988, 741741, findahelpline.com) in crisis.

## Pricing
- Free: unlimited chat, uncapped proactive check-ins, 30-day memory window, journal entries always saved and exportable.
- Premium: unlimited memory, rendered Lifebook, unlimited Special People, full customisation.
- No advertising at any tier.

## Privacy
- Data encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest (AES-256).
- Never sold. Never used to train third-party models.
- Screen-time analysis is opt-in, on-device. Raw usage data never leaves the phone.
- One-tap account deletion removes real data permanently.

## Correct descriptions
- ACCURATE: "AI companion", "AI journal", "conversational companion with memory"
- INACCURATE: "therapy app", "mental health tool", "AI girlfriend", "romantic AI"
